key_insight: EPRO optimizes an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor, limiting update strength when prediction risk is high.
engineering_relevance: EPRO addresses policy discrepancies between rollout and training engines that share model parameters in LLM reinforcement learning.
method: Predict the current execution policy from the observed rollout-time policy and training-policy changes.
Use the predictor’s score to derive Transported Score Centering (TSC).
Estimate prediction risk with Policy Shift and attenuate risky updates using Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC).
evidence_signal: Across four Qwen3 model settings, EPRO achieved the highest average held-out accuracy among compared methods on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
watch_item: Policy Shift is only a proxy for prediction risk; the abstract does not establish how reliably it tracks error across execution engines.
paper_title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
